title: serious or undo
name: Serious or undo — NN/g
rule: Before actions with serious consequences (especially those that cannot be undone), use a confirmation dialog, or offer an undo window; never make destruction immediate.

citation.source: NN/g — Confirmation Dialogs (§1); NN/g — Cancel vs Close (ask for confirmation); Vercel Web Interface Guidelines (destructive actions need confirmation modal or undo)

pass_when: Serious / irreversible actions have a confirmation dialog or an undo window; destruction is not immediate.
fail_when: Immediate irreversible destructive commit with neither confirm nor undo.
overview: Serious or irreversible actions get a confirm dialog or an undo window.
apply_when: Destructive or hard-to-reverse actions are about to commit.
not_when: Easily reversible routine edits that need neither confirm nor undo.
agent_hint: Block immediate destruction; require confirm or provide an undo window.
description: Actions with serious consequences—ones that cannot be undone—must not commit immediately. Show a confirmation dialog or offer an undo window so people can back out after a slip or second thought. Immediate irreversible destruction with neither confirm nor undo is a failure of protection. Soft, easily reversible edits can proceed without this gate; reserve it for real lasting harm.
